in_marathi.name: Nerisa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nerisa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nerisa is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nir' meaning 'not' and 'Isha' meaning 'goddess'. In Hindu mythology, Nerisa is a manifestation of the Moon Goddess, who represents the feminine energy and is believed to protect and nurture. Her name signifies the absence of sorrow and bestows the blessings of fertility, prosperity, and peace.
